newsitem.title: JAPAN: US Fed's Greenspan to speak in Tokyo on Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: US Fed's Greenspan to speak in Tokyo on Nov 18.

text.p: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan will give a lecture in Tokyo on "Banking in the Global Market Place" on November 18, the Federation of Bankers Associations of Japan said in a statement on Thursday.
Greenspan will come to Japan in mid-November at the invitation of Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita, the statement said.
A BOJ spokesman said earlier Greenspan would meet Matsushita during the visit but gave no details of his schedule.
